close_reason: Crate-level docs added to jmap-chat-types explaining serde construction pattern with examples. Committed to upstream repo.
description: The #[non_exhaustive] types in jmap-chat-types (Attachment, Reaction, MessageRevision, etc.) are intentionally constructed via serde_json::from_value(json\!({...})). This is the designed API pattern — not a workaround. Add crate-level documentation explaining this pattern with examples, so downstream consumers don't file PRs asking for new() constructors.
title: Document serde construction pattern in jmap-chat-types
